en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a small coastal village in a rocky archipelago. Wooden houses with pitched roofs line the shoreline around a calm bay in which a small sailboat is moored. Rugged granite cliffs surround the water, and a pier and boathouses extend into the bay. In the foreground, a house and dense bushes sit on rocky terrain. Printed caption text appears at the lower left and a small publisher's logo with a number appears at the lower right.
